# /api/ literals the dashboard source contains that no call rule can place.
#
# The ratchet's completeness guard reports every ``/api/`` string in the
# frontend source that rules 1-3 of ``scan_source_dir`` could not attribute to
# a call. Each one has to be named here with a reason, so a new indirection
# that the extractor cannot follow becomes a failing test instead of a
# silently smaller audit surface. Entries are matched by PATH.
# Format: METHOD PATH # reason

POST /api/chat/stream # SSE: Chat.vue calls the stream() helper from composables/useStreamingFetch.js, so the URL literal and the fetch(url) site live in different files — no same-file rule can join them
GET /api/prometheus # not a request at all: Observability.vue renders the string as the detail text of a status card
